test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

In __according to__ his advice I took this medicine.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**accordance with**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**In accordance with**": This phrase is the correct and standard way to express conformity or agreement with some
